title: anomalyco/opencode open source coding agent architecture and session runtime study
observations: OpenCode is an Effect.ts-based monorepo coding agent separating durable prompt admission from model execution.
SystemContext organizes privileged context into typed sources with baseline/update/removed renderers and ContextEpoch provider-cache prefix reuse.
Session execution uses process-local coordination (Session Drain) rather than durable entity wrappers, recovering from prompts, history, provider attempts, and tool state.
Tool execution applies generic output bounding (max lines/bytes) at settlement and spills full output to managed temporary files.
Permission system evaluates action/resource wildcards dynamically per-agent and persists 'always' allow rules per-project.
Catalog maintains provider/model availability, default model selection, cost/age small model heuristics, and policy enforcement.
EmbeddedOpenCode executes the Server HttpRouter in-memory with the same OpenCodeClient and scoped lifecycle.
